deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen's AI-assisted product description writing, start by integrating the tool with your existing Shopify platform using Zapier or a similar integration service. Next, set up custom templates within Claude API to reflect Baukjen's brand voice and style guidelines. Finally, train the model on a dataset of existing product descriptions to ensure it accurately captures the nuances of Baukjen's fashion content.
